responsibilities: Node-API module registration and value conversion
locally implemented integer, polynomial, and factoring helpers
files.rationale: The boundary is legitimate, but a 4,401-line adapter cannot make ownership of locally implemented mathematics visible. Split registration and representation primitives from algorithms, then assess each local algorithm against typed Python and mature FLINT operations.
files.fallback: Existing ordinary Python arithmetic remains the capability fallback while each exported operation is separated.
files.next: Create a symbol-level inventory and extract one representation-neutral helper family per change set.

files.rationale: This is Sage.js-owned mathematical code over a mature FLINT representation. Keep FLINT polynomial primitives, but make the row-reduction control flow a future typed-Python witness once packed polynomial buffers are available.
files.fallback: The current native implementation remains capability-gated until an ordinary Python body has matching correctness and performance evidence.
files.next: Define a packed cyclotomic-row ABI and differential corpus before attempting migration.

files.next: Separate conversion-only exports from character assembly and benchmark batched packed output.

responsibilities: FLINT dense and sparse matrix calls
locally implemented matrix algorithms and conversion paths
files.rationale: The largest mixed native source combines an essential packed FLINT boundary with Sage.js-owned algorithms. Retain mature FLINT calls, split the ABI by representation, and use existing prime-field typed witnesses to migrate local control flow where it is competitive.
files.fallback: Every matrix operation retains its tested Python/JavaScript implementation or an explicit native capability diagnostic.
files.next: Generate an export-to-implementation map and prioritize algorithms that do not directly delegate to FLINT.

responsibilities: boundary, Hecke, star, and cuspidal computations
host-neutral packed result ownership shared by Node and Wasm
files.rationale: The host-neutral core is substantially better than duplicating Node and Wasm algorithms, but it remains Sage.js-owned mathematical C adapted from PARI. Preserve its packed ABI as an oracle and migrate control flow after P1 and sparse exact storage are proven compiler domains.
files.fallback: Strict Python modular-symbol algorithms remain the semantic reference; Node and Wasm continue using this core during staged migration.
files.next: Use the P1 pilot to establish packed records, then select one complete Manin relation stage for source-transparent compilation.

files.rationale: The core mathematics is a mature FLINT algorithm and should not be recreated. Keep the bridge, but isolate conversion and ownership from any policy-level factor selection.
files.fallback: The operation is an explicit FLINT capability with tested dynamic behavior when unavailable.
files.next: Document the packed polynomial ABI and keep further mathematical control flow out of the adapter.

responsibilities: integer and rational sparse star eigenspaces
files.rationale: This file is the clearest architecture violation: an adapter contains several independent research algorithms and low-level exact-memory management. The continued-fraction Heilbronn enumeration and fused higher-weight Hecke traversal are now source-transparent typed-Python implementations; sparse exact elimination follows only after packed records and rational storage are compiler features.
files.fallback: The production higher-weight Hecke traversal retains its ordinary CPython body as the same-source fallback; the existing C implementation remains an explicit differential and performance oracle.
files.next: Keep the production traversal differential corpus representative, then isolate presentation construction or sparse rational elimination as the next independently justified migration stage.

files.fallback: Dynamic P1 normalization and enumeration remain available in mathematical Python.
files.next: Add source-transparent normalization and packed pair-buffer witnesses after the Heilbronn pilot.

files.next: Specify sparse-row ownership independently of elimination and construct adversarial differential matrices.
